items.title: Koamas at Theveli International Conference 2026
items.summary: Koamas was at Theveli International Conference 2026, hosted by The Maldives National University, on this year's theme: “Transformative Innovation in the 21st Century: Science, Technology and Society.”
body: James Ray presented "Expanding Cetacean Monitoring Across the Maldives: Photo-Identification of Odontocetes at Kuda Huraa and Landaa Giraavaru, 2017–2026, and the Beginning of a National Sightings Database," co-authored with Samay Rao, Rylee Johansen, Edward Hodges, Marie Saleem and Thomas Le Berre.

The talk traced nine years of dolphin photo-identification work at the Four Seasons Kuda Huraa and Landaa Giraavaru resorts, and set out how that work is now feeding into Koamas — the WhatsApp-based citizen sightings network extending monitoring across the wider Maldivian archipelago.

items.title: Koamas at the MMRI symposium
items.summary: Koamas presented the WhatsApp-based sighting network at the MMRI symposium, setting out how citizen reports are verified and turned into an open record of Maldivian cetaceans.
